name: 跨数据库锁监控对比诊断
description: 锁监控是数据库性能诊断的核心能力。Oracle 使用 V$LOCK + V$SESSION 关联分析锁等待链；MySQL 8.0 使用 performance_schema.data_locks + data_lock_waits（5.7 用 INNODB_LOCKS + INNODB_LOCK_WAITS）；PostgreSQL 使用 pg_locks + pg_stat_activity。三者的锁类型分类、粒度和监控方式差异很大，但核心问题相同：找出谁持锁、谁在等、等多久。

signals.desc: 需要对比不同数据库的锁监控方法
检测到锁等待但不清楚如何跨数据库类型对比分析

skip_when.desc: 单一数据库环境且已有完善锁监控

root_causes.name: MySQL 锁等待未被及时发现
root_causes.desc: MySQL 行锁等待默认超时 innodb_lock_wait_timeout=50 秒。8.0 的 data_locks/data_lock_waits 表实时显示锁持有和等待关系。5.7 的 INNODB_LOCKS 只有在产生等待时才能看到。sys.innodb_lock_waits 视图提供更易读的格式。

root_causes.name: Oracle 锁分析方法
root_causes.desc: Oracle V$LOCK 记录所有锁信息，通过 V$LOCK.BLOCK=1 找到 blocker，关联 V$SESSION 获取会话详情。Oracle 的锁类型丰富（TX/TM/MR/TS 等），其中 TX 是事务行锁，TM 是 DML 表锁。

root_causes.name: PostgreSQL 锁分析方法
root_causes.desc: PG pg_locks 记录所有锁，通过 pg_locks.granted = false 找到等待者。pg_blocking_pids() 函数（9.6+）直接返回阻塞者 PID。PG 的锁类型：AccessShare/RowShare/RowExclusive/ShareUpdate/Share/ShareRowExclusive/Exclusive/AccessExclusive。

root_causes.name: 死锁检测差异
root_causes.desc: MySQL InnoDB 自动检测死锁并回滚代价小的事务（innodb_deadlock_detect=ON）。Oracle 也自动检测。PG 通过 deadlock_timeout（默认 1 秒）延迟后检测。三者都会记录死锁信息但日志格式不同。

step1_mysql_lock_waits.sql: SELECT r.trx_id AS waiting_trx, r.trx_mysql_thread_id AS waiting_thread, r.trx_query AS waiting_query, b.trx_id AS blocking_trx, b.trx_mysql_thread_id AS blocking_thread, b.trx_query AS blocking_query FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx r ON w.REQUESTING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID = r.trx_id JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx b ON w.BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID = b.trx_id
step1_mysql_lock_waits.version_note: 8.0+ 使用 data_lock_waits。5.7 使用 information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS

step2_mysql_sys_view.desc: MySQL: 使用 sys schema 简化视图
step2_mysql_sys_view.version_note: sys schema 5.7+ 内置，8.0+ 自动适配新表名

step3_mysql_57_lock_waits.sql: SELECT r.trx_id AS waiting_trx, r.trx_mysql_thread_id AS waiting_pid, b.trx_id AS blocking_trx, b.trx_mysql_thread_id AS blocking_pid, rl.lock_table, rl.lock_index, rl.lock_mode FROM information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS w JOIN information_schema.INNODB_LOCKS rl ON w.requested_lock_id = rl.lock_id JOIN information_schema.INNODB_LOCKS bl ON w.blocking_lock_id = bl.lock_id JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx r ON r.trx_id = w.requesting_trx_id JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx b ON b.trx_id = w.blocking_trx_id

step4_mysql_deadlocks.desc: MySQL: 查看最近的死锁信息
step4_mysql_deadlocks.note: 搜索 LATEST DETECTED DEADLOCK 部分。8.0+ 也可查 performance_schema.events_errors_summary_global_by_error WHERE ERROR_NUMBER=1213

step5_oracle_reference.sql:
-- Oracle SQL (参考):
-- SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.program, l.type, l.lmode, l.request, l.block
-- FROM v$lock l JOIN v$session s ON l.sid = s.sid
-- WHERE l.block = 1 OR l.request > 0
-- ORDER BY l.block DESC, l.request DESC

step6_pg_reference.sql:
-- PostgreSQL SQL (参考):
-- SELECT blocked_locks.pid AS blocked_pid, blocked_activity.usename, blocking_locks.pid AS blocking_pid, blocking_activity.usename AS blocking_user
-- FROM pg_locks blocked_locks
-- JOIN pg_stat_activity blocked_activity ON blocked_locks.pid = blocked_activity.pid
-- JOIN pg_locks blocking_locks ON blocked_locks.transactionid = blocking_locks.transactionid AND blocked_locks.pid != blocking_locks.pid
-- JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking_activity ON blocking_locks.pid = blocking_activity.pid
-- WHERE NOT blocked_locks.granted

version_specific_notes.5.7: 使用 INNODB_LOCKS + INNODB_LOCK_WAITS（information_schema）。sys.innodb_lock_waits 视图可用。死锁信息通过 SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS
version_specific_notes.8.0: INNODB_LOCKS/INNODB_LOCK_WAITS 移除，替换为 performance_schema.data_locks/data_lock_waits。data_locks 可以看到所有持有的锁（不仅是有等待的）。sys.innodb_lock_waits 自动适配
version_specific_notes.8.4: 锁监控性能优化。data_locks 表扫描开销降低。死锁日志格式改进

real_world_examples.scenario: 从 Oracle 迁移到 MySQL 后锁监控方式不熟悉
real_world_examples.symptoms: DBA 习惯用 V$LOCK 查锁，迁移到 MySQL 后不知道等价方式
real_world_examples.root_cause: MySQL 和 Oracle 锁监控接口差异大
real_world_examples.resolution: 建立对照表：V$LOCK → data_locks, V$SESSION → processlist/threads, V$LOCK.BLOCK → data_lock_waits
real_world_examples.result: DBA 快速掌握 MySQL 锁诊断方法
